'''Kelly''' (Japanese: '''カナタ''' ''Kanata'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] from [[Lilycove City]] who first appeared in ''[[AG090|Pokéblock, Stock, and Berry]]''.

==History==
===''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]''===
[[File:Kelly and May.png|220px|thumb|left|Kelly and May]]
After meeting at the {{ci|Lilycove}} [[Berry]] markets, {{an|May}} and Kelly quickly became friends and [[rival]]s in the upcoming [[Pokémon Contest]]. Kelly escorted the group to [[Mrs. Otter|her mother's]] [[Pokéblock]] store, where May was introduced to Pokéblock making and a [[Berry Blender]] for the first time.

In ''[[AG091|Lessons in Lilycove]]'', using her {{TP|May|Combusken}}, May got off to a bad start, but managed to scrape through the Lilycove Contest's [[Appeal]]s Round. Kelly, on the other hand, was very successful in making her way through, earning herself a 27.6 for her Grumpig's Pokéblock juggling performance. 

Eventually, Kelly faced off against May in the final round of the Contest. Her {{p|Grumpig}} {{pkmn|battle}}d hard, quickly taking control of the round with {{m|Psychic}}. However, May overcame Psychic by having Combusken aim a {{m|Fire Spin}} at the ceiling, dealing damage to Grumpig and causing it to eventually lose control of its Psychic attack. When time ran out, May had the most points remaining and won the Contest, earning her third [[Ribbon]]. Shortly after this, Kelly congratulated May, with both of them claiming they learned much from each other, and that they would both be ready for the next time they met up in a Contest battle.

In ''[[AG121|Hi Ho Silver Wind!]]'', it was revealed that Kelly sent May a letter in the post, wishing her luck in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]].

Kelly was also seen very briefly at home watching the Hoenn Grand Festival on [[television]] in ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]''.

===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''===
In ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'', Kelly and her Grumpig were seen watching {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}}'s [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{Ash}} on [[television]].

==Character==
Kelly is a fiery individual, who trains hard to prove that she is the best. While she is currently embarking on becoming a [[Top Coordinator]], her long-term goal and real passion is to take over [[Otane|her mother's]] [[Pokéblock]] store.

She is upbeat, and encouraged {{an|May}} while she experimented with making her own [[Pokéblock]] in ''[[AG090|Pokéblock, Stock, and Berry]]''. This attribute was also showcased during her {{ci|Lilycove}} {{pkmn|Contest}} performance, where she got the crowd involved by clapping along. Kelly utilizes a an experimental approach in her Contests, often taking control of the rounds with her unconventional methods and Grumpig's {{m|Psychic}} attack.
